outcome: Neonatal outcomes (NICU admission, 1-minute APGAR score, respiratory distress)
finding: The rising primary caesarean section rate was associated with increased neonatal morbidity, including NICU admissions and low 1-minute APGAR scores.
mod_finding: The study observed a rising trend of Cesarean sections, with fetal distress being the most common indication for primary Cesarean section.
